{{Short description|German chemist}}
'''Katharina Kohse-Höinghaus''' (born 18 December 1951) is a German chemist.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/mitglieder/mitgliederverzeichnis/member/1294/|title=Mitgliederverzeichnis|website=www.leopoldina.org|language=de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref>

== Life ==
Kohse-Höinghaus studied Chemistry at the [[Ruhr University Bochum]] from 1970 to 1975.<ref name=":0" /> She finished her doctorate at the [[Ruhr University Bochum]] in 1978 and her habilitation at the [[University of Stuttgart]] in 1992.<ref name=":0" /> Since 1994, she is a professor for physical chemistry at the [[Bielefeld University]].<ref name=":0" />  She founded one of the first hands-on laboratories for schools.<ref name=":0" /> She served as the President of [[The Combustion Institute]] between 2012 and 2016.

== Research ==
Her research focuses on  combustion diagnostics using laser spectroscopy and mass spectrometry, the deposition of functional materials from the gas-phase, and the in-situ analysis of reactive systems.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.leopoldina.org/fileadmin/redaktion/Mitglieder/CV_Kohse-Hoeinghaus_Katharina_EN.pdf|title=CV Kohse-Höinghaus|website=www.leopoldina.org|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref>

== Awards and memberships ==
She received the following awards and memberships:

* [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany]] in 2007<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nwzonline.de/oldenburg/bildung/bundespraesident-ehrt-oldenburgerin_a_5,1,643206006.html|title=AUSZEICHNUNG BERLIN/OLDENBURG: Bundespräsident ehrt Oldenburgerin|last=Nordwest-Zeitung|website=www.nwzonline.de|date=5 September 2007 |language=de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref>
* Member of the [[Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]] since 2008<ref name=":0" /> 
*Member of the [[German Council of Science and Humanities]] since 2012<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.radiobielefeld.de/nachrichten/archiv-lokales/detailansicht/kohse-hoeinghaus-im-wissenschaftsrat.html|title=Kohse-Höinghaus im Wissenschaftsrat|website=www.radiobielefeld.de|date=30 January 2012 |language=de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref>
* Member of the [[acatech]] since 2015<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.acatech.de/Person/katharina-kohse-hoeinghaus-universitaet-bielefeld/|title=Katharina Kohse-Höinghaus Universität Bielefeld|website=acatech|language=de-DE|access-date=2018-12-15|archive-date=2018-12-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181216031547/https://www.acatech.de/Person/katharina-kohse-hoeinghaus-universitaet-bielefeld/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* Member of the [[Göttingen Academy of Sciences and Humanities]] since 2016<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://adw-goe.de/mitglieder/personendetails/person/katharina-kohse-hoeinghaus/|title=Prof. Dr. Katharina Kohse-Höinghaus: Akademie der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen (AdW)|website=adw-goe.de|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref>
* Member of the North Rhine-Westphalian Academy of Sciences, Humanities and the Arts since 2017<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.awk.nrw.de/akademie/klassen/naturmedizin/ordentliche-mitglieder/kohse-hoeinghaus-katharina.html|title=AWK: Kohse-Höinghaus, Katharina|website=www.awk.nrw.de|access-date=2018-12-15|archive-date=2018-12-16|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181216031152/http://www.awk.nrw.de/akademie/klassen/naturmedizin/ordentliche-mitglieder/kohse-hoeinghaus-katharina.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>
* Member of the [[European Academy of Sciences and Arts]] since 2017<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.eurasc.org/members/members.asp?Cognome=k|title=European Academy of Sciences – List of Members|website=www.eurasc.org|access-date=2018-12-15}}</ref>
* Fellow of [[The Combustion Institute]] since 2018<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.combustioninstitute.org/resources/awards/fellows-of-the-combustion-institute/|publisher=The Combustion Institute|title=Fellows of The Combustion Institute|newspaper=The Combustion Institute &#124; Promoting and Disseminating Combustion Science Research|date=20 June 2017|access-date=2022-09-19|archive-date=2023-06-08|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230608051502/https://www.combustioninstitute.org/resources/awards/fellows-of-the-combustion-institute/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
*Walther Nernst Memorial Medal by the {{ill|Deutsche Bunsen-Gesellschaft für Physikalische Chemie|de}} in 2020<ref>{{Cite journal|date=2020-06-11|title=GDCh Awards 2020/DBG Awards 2020|url=https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/abs/10.1002/anie.202005849|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|volume=59|issue=28|language=en|pages=11189–11190|doi=10.1002/anie.202005849|pmid=32529688|s2cid=219606004 |issn=1433-7851|url-access=subscription}}</ref>
*Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] since 2021<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.combustioninstitute.org/news/former-ci-president-elected-to-cas/|title=Former CI President Elected to CAS|date=22 November 2021|access-date=2022-01-18|archive-date=2022-01-18|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220118175817/https://www.combustioninstitute.org/news/former-ci-president-elected-to-cas/|url-status=dead}}</ref>
